evidence.notes: SOSL Search.query filters local Product2 fixed search rows through matching PricebookEntry rows.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSOSLWithPricebookIdTest { @isTest static void filtersProductRowsByPricebookEntry() { Id pricebookId = Test.getStandardPricebookId(); Product2 kept = new Product2(Name = 'Kept Trail Saw', IsActive = true); Product2 skipped = new Product2(Name = 'Skipped Trail Saw', IsActive = true); insert new List<Product2>{ kept, skipped }; insert new PricebookEntry(Pricebook2Id = pricebookId, Product2Id = kept.Id, UnitPrice = 7, IsActive = true); Test.setFixedSearchResults(new List<Id>{ kept.Id, skipped.Id }); List<Product2> rows = (List<Product2>)Search.query('FIND {Trail Saw} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Product2(Id, Name) WITH PricebookId = \'01s000000000001\'')[0]; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals(kept.Id, rows[0].Id); System.assertEquals('Kept Trail Saw', rows[0].Name); } }
